pwa.title: Install Synqit
pwa.headline: Keep Synqit one tap away on your phone.
pwa.body: Install the app to jump straight into your dashboard, playlists, and guest activity without opening a browser tab first.
pwa.instantInstallBody: Your device is ready. Confirm the install prompt and Synqit will be added to your home screen or app launcher.

pwa.iosStepThreeBody: Tap Add in the top-right corner. Synqit will appear on your home screen like a regular app.

hero.title: Collaborative playlists, without forcing guests to sign up.
hero.description: Synqit gives hosts a shareable link. Guests open it, search songs, and contribute in seconds while tracks land directly in the host provider playlist.
hero.helper: Built for fast guest contribution on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

why.title: Why hosts choose Synqit for playlists
why.description: Structured for clarity and speed: create, share, collect tracks, moderate.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Connect provider, create the playlist playlist, and generate a magic link.
how.step2Body: Guests open the link and contribute songs from the host provider catalog.
how.step3Body: Host reviews tracks, removes items, and closes the playlist when ready.

cards.hostBody: Connect provider, create playlist, copy the magic link in under a minute.
